parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the secondary cluster that you want to remove from the GDN.

> You can call the [DescribeGlobalDatabaseNetwork](~~264580~~) operation to query the IDs of clusters in the GDN.

parameters.name: Force
parameters.description: Specifies whether to forcibly remove the cluster.

parameters.name: TargetDBClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the target cluster.
